versions.subject: feat: add/update rules related to odbcconf (#4228)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\odbcconf.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'odbcconf.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -f '
        - ' /f '
selection_rsp_ext:
    CommandLine|contains: '.rsp'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\odbcconf.exe" OR OriginalFileName="odbcconf.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -f *", "* /f *") CommandLine="*.rsp*"

condition: all of selection_*
